claude.finalText:
I made two changes, both for models or interfaces that no longer work. Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) is clean, but I haven't run any live API calls.

**What I changed**
1. **OpenAI Realtime** (`src/realtime/realtime-voice.service.ts`). OpenAI's [deprecations page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md) says the `gpt-4o-realtime-preview` models were shut down on 2026-05-07. It also says the `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` interface was removed on 2026-05-12. So the voice proxy can't connect as written. I switched it to the GA interface, following the [beta-to-GA guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/realtime):
   - The model is now `gpt-realtime-2.1`.
   - I removed the `OpenAI-Beta` header.
   - `session.update` now sends `type: 'realtime'` and puts the voice under `audio.output.voice`.
   - The audio event it listens for is now `response.output_audio.delta`, not `response.audio.delta`.
2. **Gemini default model.** Google's [deprecations page](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations) says `gemini-2.0-flash` was shut down on 2026-06-01 and recommends `gemini-3.6-flash`. I changed the default in three places: `proposal-plan-generator.service.ts`, `task-assignment-llm.service.ts` and `dispatch-email-llm.service.ts`. I also updated `.env.example` and the docs in `docs/`, and replaced the `gemini-1.5-flash` fallback example in a comment with `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`.

**Flagged, not changed**
- **`gpt-4o-mini` default.** It is used in many services and in `.env.example`. OpenAI [lists](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md) `gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18` for shutdown on 2027-01-14, with `gpt-6-luna` as the replacement. I left it alone because it still works today and `OPENAI_MODEL` can override it. The code also passes `max_tokens` and `temperature` to Chat Completions. I couldn't confirm that `gpt-6-luna` accepts them. The model page says it is a reasoning model, and that Chat Completions supports function calling only with `reasoning_effort` set to `none`. Test that swap before January.
- **`@google/generative-ai` SDK.** I believe Google has superseded it with `@google/genai`, but I didn't check this. It still works with the new model names, so I didn't migrate it.

Sources:
- [OpenAI deprecations](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md)
- [OpenAI Realtime guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/realtime)
- [Gemini deprecations](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations)

handled.change: OpenAI Realtime GA migration and model retirement
handled.note: Same core changes as A, plus explicit 24 kHz PCM input and output formats and output_modalities ['audio']. Consistent with the GA interface. Also adds a test.

Switches every default to gpt-6-luna and renames max_tokens to max_completion_tokens in three calls. This is premature, since the model still works, but consistent with the notice. The swap to a reasoning model is unverified for the other call sites.

breaks: Misses the gemini-2.0-flash shutdown: three services still default to a model that has already been shut down, so the primary Gemini path fails unless GEMINI_MODEL is set.
Removes temperature from three calls, which changes output behaviour. Combined with the forced move to a reasoning model before the current one retires, this may change latency and cost.
Changes .env.example and the docs so users are steered to gpt-6-luna before it is needed.
The added test asserts that no 'gpt-4o' string appears anywhere in src. This is a brittle repo-wide grep test.

handled.change: OpenAI Realtime: gpt-4o-realtime-preview shut down and the OpenAI-Beta realtime=v1 interface removed
handled.note: Switches to gpt-realtime-2.1, drops the beta header, uses the GA session.update shape (type 'realtime', voice under audio.output) and renames the event to response.output_audio.delta. This matches the cited GA guide. Transcript and text event names in the unshown part of the handler may also need checking.
Updates the default model to gemini-3.6-flash in all three services that call Gemini, plus .env.example and the fallback example in a comment. This fixes a default that is already broken.

Flagged rather than changed. That is reasonable: the model still works, OPENAI_MODEL can override it, and A correctly notes that the reasoning-model replacement may not accept max_tokens or temperature.

judge.why: Both migrate the Realtime proxy correctly. A also fixes the gemini-2.0-flash defaults, which are already shut down and actively break the primary path in three services; B misses this entirely. B instead makes a premature, riskier swap of all gpt-4o-mini defaults to a reasoning model and drops temperature, while A sensibly flags that swap for later.
